role: Gate: rebuilds every chest loot draw of the oracle's LootProbe (seeded Random, structure table, count expression, slot count) through csrc/engine/loot.c and compares slot by slot as canonical ItemStack NBT, and rebuilds each case's enchanted book from its bookSeed.

structs.name: case_def
structs.java: one manifest case: loot table name, structure call and count expressions, slot count, book seed and book NBT

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/loot. Native calls: loot_table_by_name, loot_count, loot_generate_contents, loot_book_build, loot_book_free, loot_free (csrc/engine/loot.h), jr_seed, nbt_* builders and nbt_diff. Reads manifest.json, draws.jsonl, books.jsonl. Structure classes come from the names LootProbe.java references. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/LootProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/loot/seed2, seed42-op4. case_def field names summarised.
